jobs.description:
Who We Are
We are looking for Artificial Intelligence Engineering Experts to lead the design, industrialization, and continuous improvement of production AI capabilities for our platform. The role will provide deep hands-on expertise across machine learning, generative AI, data and model pipelines, evaluation, deployment, MLOps or LLMOps, observability, security, and operational reliability.
The experts will work with Product, Architecture, Data, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and business stakeholders to identify viable use cases and convert experimentation into governed, measurable, maintainable services. They will establish technical standards, challenge weak assumptions, manage AI-specific risks, and mentor teams in sound engineering and scientific practices.
What You'll Be Doing
Assess proposed AI use cases for technical feasibility, data readiness, expected value, operational constraints, risk, and appropriate build, buy, or reuse options
Define AI engineering reference architectures, reusable components, lifecycle standards, guardrails, and decision criteria for machine-learning and generative-AI solutions
Lead solution design across data preparation, feature or context engineering, model selection, experimentation, training or fine-tuning, evaluation, serving, integration, and monitoring
Develop and optimize production AI components, including predictive models, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vector search, generative workflows, tool use, and agentic orchestration where justified
Establish reproducible experimentation, source control, dataset and model versioning, metadata capture, benchmark management, and clear promotion criteria
Design and implement MLOps or LLMOps pipelines for automated testing, packaging, security checks, deployment, rollback, model or prompt promotion, and environment consistency
Create rigorous evaluation frameworks covering task performance, robustness, groundedness, hallucination, safety, bias, explainability, latency, scalability, and cost as applicable
Define production monitoring for model and data quality, drift, usage, errors, safety events, service performance, resource consumption, and business outcomes
Apply security, privacy, responsible-AI, and regulatory-by-design controls, including data minimization, access control, provenance, human oversight, misuse prevention, and auditable records
Lead technical reviews, proofs of value, architecture decisions, technology assessments, and root-cause analyses for material AI incidents or performance degradation
Collaborate with application engineers to expose AI capabilities through reliable APIs, services, event flows, and user experiences with appropriate fallback behavior
Document data assumptions, model choices, experiments, limitations, evaluation evidence, dependencies, operational procedures, risks, and technical decisions
Mentor AI, data, and software engineers, promote knowledge sharing, and raise engineering maturity across delivery teams
Track relevant AI engineering developments and recommend adoption only when evidence demonstrates value, feasibility, and acceptable risk
What You'll Bring Along
Deep knowledge of machine-learning engineering, model development lifecycles, statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and production inference
Strong hands-on Python experience and familiarity with frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies
Advanced understanding of generative-AI engineering, large language models, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, prompt or context engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration
Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, data quality, lineage, distributed processing, SQL or NoSQL stores, and secure access to enterprise information
Experience with MLOps or LLMOps practices, experiment tracking, model registries, pipeline orchestration, containerization, cloud AI services, and automated deployment
Strong knowledge of model evaluation, benchmarking, error analysis, drift detection, explainability, robustness, safety testing, and human-in-the-loop validation
Understanding of AI security, privacy, responsible-AI, governance, intellectual-property, and regulatory control considerations
Ability to design reliable distributed services, APIs, batch or streaming pipelines, observability, capacity models, and production-support processes for AI workloads
Strong scientific reasoning, systems thinking, technical leadership, documentation, and communication skills
Ability to explain complex AI trade-offs to engineering, product, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders
Professional working proficiency in English to understand technical and scientific documentation and communicate effectively with international teams
Proven expert-level track record designing, delivering, and operating production machine-learning or generative-AI systems
Experience working with AI assistant platforms and CLI tools
Demonstrable ability to move from experimentation to reliable, monitored, secure, and maintainable production services
Experience providing technical leadership across data, AI, Agent development, software engineering, architecture, platform, security, and governance stakeholders
Strong hands-on engineering capability; profiles limited to research, strategy, or demonstrations without production ownership will not be sufficient
Ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and to define measurable acceptance and operational criteria for AI behavior
Proactive, rigorous, collaborative, and continuous-improvement mindset with strong ownership of AI quality and operational risk
Relevant AI, machine-learning, cloud, data, security, or architecture certifications are desirable but not mandatory

jobs.title: Booking Holdings Romania - Python Developer - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.
As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the world’s leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through five-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable.
Role Description
As a Data Engineer, you will independently design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines and platforms that power analytics, experimentation, and product decision-making across the organisation. You take ownership of the quality and reliability of the workflows you build, and you work closely with software engineers, data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, well-modeled, and trustworthy data is available at scale.
This role sits within the Product Security department and helps build software to protect the world's largest travel platform against attacks to its account & authorisation system.
This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.
Key Job Responsibilities And Duties
Design, build, and operate data pipelines and Airflow workflows (DAGs) (batch and/or streaming) to ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources into analytics and operational data stores.
Develop and maintain data models (e.g. dimensional, vault, or other analytical models) that are consistent, well-documented, and optimised for downstream use cases.
Ensure data quality and reliability end-to-end by implementing validation, monitoring, testing, and alerting across pipelines, Airflow workflows, and datasets, with clear SLOs and error budgets where applicable.
Own the operational excellence of the workflows you develop, including on-call participation where relevant, incident triage, troubleshooting, and driving root-cause analysis and follow-ups to prevent regressions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs, translate them into technical solutions, and enable self-service access to data where appropriate.
Operate and improve big data platforms and tooling, following modern data engineering best practices, version control, and CI/CD workflows.
Manage data governance aspects within your scope: ownership of datasets, documentation, access control, and alignment with security and privacy requirements.
Contribute to craft standards and frameworks, sharing best practices, improving shared Airflow patterns and libraries, and mentoring more junior engineers where relevant.
Role Qualifications And Requirements
Proven experience (3+ years) as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused engineering role, working with large-scale or complex datasets
Strong skills in at least one programming language commonly used for data engineering (preferably Python, Java is also acceptable).
Hands-on experience with data processing frameworks (e.g. Spark, Flink, Beam or similar) and SQL for working with relational and analytical databases.
Practical experience designing, implementing, and operating Airflow DAGs(or similar workflow orchestration tools), including dependency management, scheduling, and observability.
Experience building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines on modern data platforms (e.g. cloud data warehouses, data lakes, or lakehouses).
Experience with stream processing and real-time data products (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis, or similar).
Understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. dimensional modeling, Data Vault, star/snowflake schemas) and how they support analytics and reporting.
Familiarity with version control, testing, and CI/CD practices for data workflows, including automated validation and deployment of Airflow changes.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while maintaining strong standards for quality, privacy, and security.
Ability to identify pragmatic opportunities to leverage AI in data engineering workflows, for example in data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, lineage insights, or incident investigation.
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, explaining trade-offs and data design decisions.
Find solutions to difficult or complex issues by applying different skills and techniques like analytical thinking, lateral thinking, and logical reasoning
Constructively improve existing ideas, plans and solutions by reviewing them in a critical yet constructive manner, initiating concrete improvements and articulating their rationale
Continuous Quality and Process Improvement
Identify opportunities for process, system and/or structural improvements, by applying an understanding of process flows and the methods that can be used to boost effectiveness and efficiency
Deliver clear, well-structured, and meaningful information to a target audience by using suitable communication mediums and language tailored to the audience
Achieve mutually agreeable solutions by staying adaptable, communicating ideas in clear coherent language and practicing active listening.
Benefits & Perks
Contributing to a high scale, complex, world-renowned product and seeing real-time impact of your work on millions of travelers worldwide
Working in a fast-paced and performance driven culture
Technical, behavioral and interpersonal competence advancement via on-the-job opportunities, experimental projects, hackathons, conferences and active community participation
Competitive Compensation And Benefits Package
Vast amounts of data to validate your ideas and the opportunity to experiment with real users
Booking Holdings is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.
Pre-Employment Screening
If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.
